scope: v1.4 synchronous MEGA65 drawing, VIC sprite and SID voice freight over existing public primitives

public_surface.m65-draw-line: (m65-draw-line x0 y0 x1 y1 character-code color) -> t
public_surface.m65-draw-fill: (m65-draw-fill x0 y0 x1 y1 character-code color) -> t
public_surface.m65-sid-voice: (m65-sid-voice voice frequency-low frequency-high control attack-decay sustain-release volume) -> t

register_authority.rule: the JSON register map is the sole hand-maintained address authority; private inline-only Lisp constant functions are generated from it and must leave no runtime entries

byte_and_word_access.word_representation: one cons pair (low-byte . high-byte); never a fixnum and no Runtime-only Buffer service
byte_and_word_access.word_start_ffff: type error before any I/O because the second byte would wrap
byte_and_word_access.bit_test_result: t when any masked bit is set, otherwise nil

drawing.surface: the current character-cell screen reported by screen-size
drawing.plot_unit: one character cell with an 8-bit character code and color 0..15
drawing.line: inclusive integer Bresenham between two in-bounds cells
drawing.fill: inclusive axis-aligned rectangle; reversed corners are rejected
drawing.bounds: both endpoints must be within the live screen dimensions before the first visible write
drawing.bitmap_exclusion: the historical $2000 H640 bitmap overlaps today's product text; Bank-4 pixels require the separately priced EDMA/flat-memory rider and are not claimed by this pilot

sprite.shape_representation: a string of exactly 63 byte-valued characters
sprite.vic_unlock_rule: the exact $47/$53 pair is private-inlined into m65-sprite-shape; no standalone %m65-vic-open code object or target TAILCALL may remain
sprite.shape_slot_rule: one pilot-owned 64-byte slot in the proven 0x17a0-0x17ff screen/island gap; all sprites may share it and loading a new shape changes every sprite that selects pointer 95
sprite.pointer_table_rule: read the live VIC-IV pointer-table address from $D06C-$D06E after the $47/$53 unlock; reject a non-Bank-0 table or a low byte above $f8 before writing
sprite.padding: byte 63 is always zeroed after the 63 payload bytes

sid.frequency: two strict byte arguments, low then high
sid.synchronous_limit: the call writes one complete voice snapshot; sequencing, envelope progression and continuous playback wait for the tick-hook block

ship_closure.policy: reachable-only through the existing ship-builder closure

execution_lanes: source-compiled P0 VM with modeled RAM, screen, VIC and SID registers
emitted-artifact P0 VM over the same independent fixtures
mutation_families: sprite index, X-MSB, pointer table, shape length or padding
SID voice stride, write order, volume bound or waveform byte
proof.execution_witness: every domain has positive source and artifact I/O counts; zero executions is red

claim_limit: Host source/artifact semantics and one WPLTO capacity card until the bundled device session proves visible drawing, sprite motion and audible SID output.
